decision: Required to start the race from the pit lane.
event_name: Date 05 September 2021 Time 13:41 2021 DUTCH GRAND PRIX 2 - 5 September 2021 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 36), have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: The front wing/nose assembly has been changed.
offence: Breach of Article 34.8 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the race from the pit lane.
reason: The changed front wing/nose assembly is of a different specification from the one used during qualifying. The part was replaced with the approval of the FIA Technical Delegate as per article 34.2. As the front wing/nose assembly is a different specification and was changed whilst the car was in parc ferme, the competitor is required to start the race from the pit lane per article 34.8 b) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
rules_referenced: Article 34.8 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 6 Front Wing Nose Assembly Specification
